lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the five visible gill slits. Specifically, posterior to the fifth gill slit, three to four columns of blobs are visible with increasing spatial separation as they progress towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a regular grid-like pattern in the mid-flank region. This intersection is most prominent in the area immediately posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a bright dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 6-8 distinct, high-luminance spots distributed across its lateral surface, with higher density observed along the anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of smaller, high-frequency luminance spots is visible on the cephalic region, anterior to the first gill slit.
